name: Account and onboarding
acceptance: Create and verify an account; sign in and load the same server profile; reject invalid credentials; record self-assessment for initial placement.
status: Partial; account integration exists, self-assessment/placement not evidenced

name: Tutorial and basic controls
acceptance: Complete or replay rule and movement steps; skipped/completed status persists for that account.

name: Structured skill training
acceptance: Select an unlocked drill, receive feedback and a 1–3 star result; only the first eligible completion earns the configured reward.

name: XP levels and cosmetic unlocks
acceptance: Award XP once per eligible command; recompute level/unlocks and preserve balances after a refresh.

name: Adaptive AI and skill coaching
acceptance: Adjust bot challenge and recommend drills from measured skill; validate initial placement and technique classifiers against labelled data.
status: Partial; Elo-tier bot and heuristic recommendations exist; ML evaluation not evidenced

name: Pickleball movement shots and rules
acceptance: Serve and execute supported shots while moving; enforce court, kitchen, net, two-bounce and scoring rules in singles and doubles.
status: Source implemented; current runtime not measured

name: Skill queue and ready confirmation
acceptance: Match eligible players; show both clients a usable ready dialog; cancel a decliner and requeue consenting players under server policy.
status: Source integrated; multi-client acceptance not run

name: Private rooms and teams
acceptance: Create/join a coded 1v1 or 2v2 room; validate membership, teams and readiness before start.
status: Source implemented; room-code flow; optional account invitation not verified

name: Online match synchronization
acceptance: Synchronize legal movement, shots and score for 1v1/2v2; apply disconnect policy and reject non-member commands.
status: Partial; Fusion Shared differs from dedicated proposal

name: Durable match result and rating
acceptance: Finalize an agreed/validated result once; atomically update Elo, wallet, history and rewards; reject conflicting duplicate reports.
status: Source integrated; client consensus trust limit

name: Personal statistics history and replay
acceptance: Read own progress and recent matches; open authorized replay data and inspect errors and frequently repeated drills.
status: Source integrated; runtime acceptance not run

name: Friends and global leaderboard
acceptance: Search and accept/remove friends; read ordered Elo standings and own position; reject unauthorized relationship changes.
status: Source integrated; runtime acceptance not run

name: Daily missions streak and achievements
acceptance: Advance eligible objectives and streaks; claim each period/reward once and refresh the server-owned state.
status: Source integrated; runtime acceptance not run

name: Offline practice and synchronization
acceptance: Complete a drill without connectivity and reconcile its permitted progress once after reconnection.
status: Gap; active runtime now requires online state

name: Administrator access and user control
acceptance: Authorize Admin only; list/filter users and apply valid ban/restore/role changes with an auditable outcome.
status: Partial; web login contract and status defect

name: Training content management
acceptance: Create/edit and publish a valid lesson/drill configuration which becomes available in the game catalog.
status: Partial; CRUD exists, playable publication gap

name: Match oversight and moderation
acceptance: Inspect live/completed matches and disconnects; review reports and appeal decisions with authorized state changes.
status: Partial; appeal and full oversight not evidenced

name: Operational and learning analytics
acceptance: Show correctly defined active-user, retention, error and queue metrics for an explicit period.
status: Partial; active-user metric is a total count
